svg.title: gitlab-architecture
svg.text: Zonal GKE clusters us-east1-b/-c/-d, gitlab namespace
CI runner managers, us-east1-c and us-east1-d
ops.gitlab.net and dev.gitlab.org, outside the production failure domain
all web, Git HTTP and Git SSH traffic
web and API into the GKE clusters
Git over SSH, port 22, as the git user
the same pool drains the mail queue
token auth: 401, client fetches a token, retries
ephemeral build VMs clone with a gitlab-ci-token
gprd-sessions and CI trace chunks, kept only in memory
Google Cloud Storage (artifacts, LFS, uploads, registry blobs)
Runner managers (GitLab Runner + Docker Machine on GCE)
Prometheus per cluster, remote-written to Mimir
